tnd-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：特立尼达阿尔贝托·德尔加多机场（TND）周边以绿色植被与农田为主。
tnd-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Alberto Delgado Airport (TND) is surrounded by green vegetation and farmland.

tnd-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 白墙入口挂着几块黑字招牌，蓝白条纹的遮阳篷罩住玻璃门，门前台阶刷着蓝色，棕榈影落在墙上。
tnd-chatgpt-01.webp.en: The white entrance wall carries black-lettered signs above a blue-and-white striped awning, with blue-painted steps below and palm shadows across the plaster.

tnd-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 游戏截图：青绿色小屋顶着红瓦屋顶，墙面挂着机场招牌，紫色栏杆与棕榈树围出大门，右上角还有罗盘图标。
tnd-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A game screenshot shows a teal gatehouse with a red tiled roof and airport signs, purple railings and palms framing the entrance, plus an on-screen compass.

tnd-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 游戏截图：青绿色平顶航站楼前停着一辆蓝白大客车，棕榈与灌木夹道，左侧浮着任务信息框。
tnd-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Another game screenshot pairs a teal, flat-roofed terminal with a blue and white coach parked outside, palms and hedges along the kerb and a task panel floating at the left.

tnd-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 机坪上停着两架小型飞机，跑道边立着一排红白相间的柱子，左侧是橙瓦屋顶的老航站楼，草地上洒满阳光。
tnd-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Two light aircraft stand on the apron before a row of red-and-white striped poles, with the orange-roofed old terminal on the left and sunlit grass around.
